sections.title: Web Apps
sections.blurb: Order, store and fulfillment tools. Open and go.

items.name: ShopWorks Bulk Order Import
items.description: Turn a bulk order CSV into a ShopWorks import file. Replaces the old GUI_V2 desktop program.

items.name: Quote Builder
items.description: Garment cost and quantities in, a priced quote and customer presentation out.

items.name: Customer Inventory Report
items.description: Drop in Brightsites inventory exports and get a branded customer report with reorders first.

items.name: Random Code Generator
items.description: Unique code batches for promos, rewards and store redemptions, with Excel-safe CSV export.

items.name: BrightSites Packing Slips
items.description: Generate and print packing slips for BrightSites orders.

items.name: EG Store Manager
items.description: Manage company and team web stores from one dashboard.

items.name: Discrepancy Report
items.description: Log and track receiving discrepancies against POs.

sections.title: Design Studios
sections.blurb: Prompt builders and layout tools for the art team. Each opens in a new tab.

items.name: Design Prompt Studio
items.description: Batch of 1–24 screen-print-ready vector prompts, tuned by niche, audience and ink count.

items.name: Sign & Vehicle Wrap Prompt Studio
items.description: Prompt generator for Eagle Sign & Design wraps, banners and signage concepts.

items.name: Web Store Banner Studio
items.description: Build store header banners with live preview and brand-ready type.

items.name: Background Knockout Studio
items.description: Remove backgrounds from product photos and logos right in the browser. Batch several and download as a zip.

items.name: Box Dieline Studio
items.description: Build a packaging dieline from 20 box styles, add artwork, fold it in 3D and export for print.

items.name: Eagle Flyer Builder
items.description: Lay out promotional flyers from templates and export for print.

sections.title: Resources
sections.blurb: Templates, email tools and brand standards.

items.name: Bulk Order CSV Template
items.description: Column layout for the ShopWorks Bulk Order Import: locations, designs, style, size, color, quantity, price.

items.name: Brand Guide
items.description: Logo downloads, colors with codes, fonts and writing rules. Start here before building anything new.

items.name: Email Signature Builder
items.description: Build a branded Eagle Graphics email signature and copy it straight into Outlook.

items.name: Email Templates
items.description: Plug-and-play Constant Contact e-blast templates: store launches, product grids, promos and more.
